lines.rookie:
Detective,
Last night the lamps did not go out on their own.
A stranger came into the lamp house.
He did not touch the fire. He did not touch the coal.
He took off the long leather belt that turns the big wheel.
I put it back at dawn. His muddy hand is still on it.
— Han
lines.junior:
Detective,
The lamps did not go out by themselves last night.
A stranger slipped into the lamp house.
He did not touch the fire. He did not touch the coal either.
He took off the long leather belt that turns the big wheel.
I put it back at dawn. His muddy handprint is still on it.
— Han
lines.master:
Detective,
Last night's darkness was no accident of the lamps.
A stranger crept into the lamp house.
He did not touch the fire. He did not touch the coal.
He took off the long leather belt that drives the big wheel.
I fitted it back at dawn. The print of his muddy hand remains on it.
— Han

lines.master: Beside one door is written 37. The board is a map of the Queen's rooms.

lines.rookie: The Queen looks at it in silence. "Someone is afraid of me," she says.
lines.junior: The Queen studies it silently. "Someone is afraid of me," she says.
lines.master: The Queen regards it without a word. "Someone fears me," she says at last.

lines.rookie: Your notes, and Lady Han's words to the King:
lines.junior: Your notes, plus Lady Han's words to the King:
lines.master: Your notes, together with what Lady Han tells the King:

lines.rookie:
The dark was made on purpose.
The strangers walked from the east gate to the Queen's hall.
The rope and the map both say 37 steps to the Queen's door.
Lady Han says: "Japan's power in Korea is growing.
The Queen works with Russia to hold back Japan's power.
Some men want her out of the way."
lines.junior:
The darkness was made on purpose.
The strangers walked from the east gate to the Queen's hall.
Both the rope and the map say 37 steps to the Queen's door.
Lady Han says: "Japan's power in Korea is getting stronger.
The Queen works with Russia to hold back Japan's power.
Some men want her out of the way."
lines.master:
The darkness was deliberate.
The strangers crossed from the east gate to the Queen's hall.
Rope and map agree: 37 steps to the Queen's door.
Lady Han says: "Japan's power in Korea grows by the day.
The Queen works with Russia to hold back Japan's power.
Certain men wish her out of the way."

lines.rookie: Whose power is the Queen trying to hold back?
lines.junior: Whose power does the Queen want to hold back?
lines.master: Whose power is the Queen striving to hold back?

lines.rookie: The Queen holds back ____'s power.
lines.junior: The Queen holds back ____'s power.
lines.master: The Queen holds back ____'s power.

lines.rookie: Read Lady Han's words. Two countries are named.
lines.junior: Read Lady Han's words. She names two countries.
lines.master: Lady Han's words name two countries.

lines.rookie: One country works WITH the Queen. Which one does she hold back?
lines.junior: The Queen works WITH one country. Which one is she holding back?
lines.master: One country stands WITH the Queen. Which does she hold back?

lines.rookie: The Queen holds back Japan's power. That is why she is watched.
lines.junior: The Queen is holding back Japan's power. That is why she is being watched.
lines.master: It is Japan's power the Queen holds back — and that is why she is watched.

lines.rookie: The King folds the map slowly.
lines.junior: The King slowly folds the map.
lines.master: Slowly, the King folds the map.

lines.rookie: Every path of this palace has been counted in steps.
lines.junior: Every path in this palace has been measured in steps.
lines.master: Every path within this palace has been counted out in steps.

lines.rookie: Lady Han puts her note in a small wooden box.
lines.junior: Lady Han places her note in a small wooden box.
lines.master: Lady Han lays her note in a small wooden box.

lines.rookie: The Queen works WITH Russia. Read Lady Han's words again.
lines.junior: The Queen works WITH Russia. Read Lady Han's words once more.
lines.master: Russia stands with the Queen, not against her. Read Lady Han's words again.

lines.rookie: China is not in Lady Han's words. Which two countries does she name?
lines.junior: Lady Han never mentions China. Which two countries does she name?
lines.master: China appears nowhere in Lady Han's words. Which two countries does she name?

lines.rookie: The Queen is Korea's Queen. Whose power is growing in Korea?
lines.junior: She is Korea's own Queen. Whose power is growing in Korea?
lines.master: She is the Queen of Korea itself. Whose power is swelling in Korea?

lines.rookie: Thank you, Detective. I will keep this map.
lines.junior: Thank you, Detective. I will keep this map safe.
lines.master: You have my thanks, Detective. This map stays with me.

lines.rookie: Korea must choose its own way. I will not stop.
lines.junior: Korea must choose its own path. I will not give up.
lines.master: Korea must choose its own way. I shall not stop.

lines.rookie: The map shows the way to the Queen's door.
lines.junior: The map leads to the Queen's door.
lines.master: The map traces the way to the Queen's door.

lines.rookie: In 1895, the Queen worked with Russia to hold back Japan's power.
lines.junior: In 1895, the Queen worked together with Russia to hold back Japan's power.
lines.master: In 1895, the Queen was working with Russia to hold back Japan's power.

lines.rookie: On 8 October 1895, men sent by Japan's minister attacked the palace.
lines.junior: On 8 October 1895, the palace was attacked by men sent by Japan's minister.
lines.master: On 8 October 1895, men dispatched by Japan's minister attacked the palace.

lines.rookie: The Queen was killed in that attack.
lines.junior: The Queen was killed during that attack.
lines.master: The Queen lost her life in that attack.

lines.rookie: I will keep our letters, and the truth of these days.
lines.junior: I will keep our letters, and the truth about these days.
lines.master: I will guard our letters, and the truth of these days.
